up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records with non-null pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1824. Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to exactly 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.assay_chembl_id,
  at.assay_type,
  at.assay_tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.assay_chembl_id IN (
    SELECT ass.chembl_id
    FROM assays ass
    JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
    WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'
      AND td.tax_id = 9606
      AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  )
ORDER BY a.molecule_chembl_id ASC, a.assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
